in_marathi.name: Khagendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of riches and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khagendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘Khaga’ meaning 'god' and ‘Indra’ meaning 'lord of riches'. This name is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and abundance.

in_bengali.name: Khagendra
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of riches and prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Khagendra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit words ‘Khaga’ meaning 'god' and ‘Indra’ meaning 'lord of riches'. This name is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and abundance.
